order: Change the guard's default behavior for an undetermined model from enforcing to standing down. Enforcement must require positive evidence of a director model in the transcript; the guard must never fall back to enforcing merely because the model is undetermined. A brand-new session's first turn — before any assistant entry is flushed — must never see a denial, and neither must an ordinary Sonnet-class or Haiku-class session at any later turn. A genuine director session must absorb exactly one unenforced opening turn, and hard enforcement must engage the instant the model reaches the transcript, never later. The existing delegation instructions already cover that single gap, so no further compensating change is needed. Update only the docs describing mode detection and troubleshooting to match the corrected default, and leave every other guard behavior unchanged.
claims: The guard now requires positive evidence of a director model before enforcing; sessions without one — including a fresh session's first turn — never see a denial. A genuine director session absorbs exactly one unenforced opening turn before hard enforcement engages the instant the model reaches the transcript, which the existing delegation instructions already cover. Docs on mode detection and troubleshooting were updated to match; the diff touches three files, 23 lines added, 18 removed.
